# Version 3.119.2
> **Platform API and hardening** · Released February 6, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/3.119.2) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v3.119.2)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](3.119.2/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/8.3.1.3/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 3.119.2 adds missing tvOS surface creation APIs and improves native binary hardening. Android symbols are now preserved in packages, helping diagnose native failures from deployed applications.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## API Surface

- **tvOS surface creation overloads completed** — Adds the missing SKSurface.Create overloads for tvOS applications. — ❤️ [@MartinZikmund](https://github.com/MartinZikmund) ([#3342](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3342))

## Platform

- **Android native symbols are packaged** — Preserves Android symbols in packages to make native crash diagnosis more useful. ([#3374](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3374))

## HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.1.3

Includes the platform packaging and native hardening work that also touched the bundled HarfBuzz delivery.
